subject: Request: Secure SDLC evidence for Acme SOC2 assessment
messages:
From: Elena Perez <elena.perez@acmecorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: BrightAudits Intake <security-assessor@brightaudits.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Secure SDLC evidence for Acme SOC2 assessment

Hi Karthik,

BrightAudits is conducting the on-site SOC2 readiness review for Acme Corp and asked us to provide a focused package of Secure SDLC artifacts by EOD Wednesday 3/11. Specifically they requested:  
- High-level code review policy and a representative code-review report (last 12 months)
- CI/CD pipeline control screenshots or export showing gated deploys, required approvals, and test coverage gates
- Secrets management evidence (rotation cadence logs, vault access control snapshots)
- Change management / deployment audit log for production rollouts in the last 6 months

Can you confirm what you can deliver and whether a single archive with named files is possible? If you have a Drive folder or a shared link, that would speed intake.

Thanks,
Elena Perez
Senior Assessor, Acme Security
On behalf of BrightAudits

Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Perez <elena.perez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:15:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Secure SDLC evidence for Acme SOC2 assessment

Elena, thanks for the clear list. We can assemble a targeted bundle by EOD 3/11. Plan:

- Dev will export the CI/CD gate artifacts and the deployment audit log.
- Neha will pull the secrets rotation history and vault ACL snapshot.
- Laura and I will include the code review policy and a representative report (redacted where needed).

Deliverables (target):
- code_review_summary_2025.zip (policy + sample reports)
- ci_pipeline_export_20260310.pdf (pipeline export with gate screenshots and required approvals)
- secrets_rotation_log_2025-03-01_to_2026-03-01.csv (rotation events + owner tags)
- change_management_audit_log_2025-2026.csv (deployment traces and ticket refs)

I'll share a secure Drive folder link once the files are uploaded. If BrightAudits needs any of these items separated (e.g., raw logs vs. summary), tell us now. Also please confirm the retention period question below — do you require logs older than 12 months?

Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123

All — attaching the export bundle we discussed. Summary of what's included below and any caveats:

Attachment stubs:
- ci_pipeline_export_20260310.pdf (contains Jenkins + ArgoCD gate screenshots; shows GitHub PR required status checks, mandatory code owners approval, and the "prod-deploy" approval step in ArgoCD)
- code_review_summary_2025.zip (policy doc: CODE_REVIEW.md, and three redacted reports: CR_report_q2_2025.json, CR_report_q4_2025.json, CR_report_q1_2026.json)
- secrets_rotation_log_2025-03-01_to_2026-03-01.csv (rotations pulled from Vault audit; includes key id, rotated_by, rotation_timestamp, rotation_type)
- change_management_audit_log_2025-2026.csv (production deploy events with ticket refs, approver, deploy window, rollback flags)

Notes / caveats:
- Sensitive entries (usernames and ticket descriptions) are redacted in the code review reports per our policy. Full logs can be made available under an NDA if needed.
- Secrets rotation events are exported from HashiCorp Vault audit; these are filtered to service-account rotations only to avoid PII exposure.
- Pipeline export includes a screenshot of the merge gate and the ArgoCD approval modal — timestamps align to the deploy events in the change management CSV.

Drive link (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDWOOD-SDLC-EVIDENCE
JIRA refs included in change log: INFRA-4821, DEPLOY-3312, PROD-119

Let me know if BrightAudits needs additional context columns (e.g., CI run IDs).

—Dev
Principal Engineer, Platform
dev_patel@redwood.com

Thanks Karthik and team — this is exactly what we needed. A couple quick clarifications before ingestion:  

1) Retention: For our scope we need deployment and rotation records going back 12 months. The CSV you provided appears to cover that window; please confirm the earliest rotation timestamp in the CSV.
2) Key rotation frequency: Could you confirm whether service keys are rotated on a time-based cadence (e.g., 90 days) or triggered by rotation events?
3) Access controls snapshot: We need a Vault ACL snapshot showing who has approver privileges for rotation and who can create tokens. A redacted snapshot is fine.

If you can reply with those three small confirmations and the Drive link we will ingest the bundle and follow up if we need raw logs. Appreciated.

Best,
Elena
Senior Assessor, Acme Security
BrightAudits
